name: Regional joint-attention boolean mask (HunyuanLoom)
plain: Adds each region's prompt tokens to the context and builds one boolean mask over text and video tokens. Each region's text can only see its own tokens and its own area, and tokens in different regions cannot see each other unless they are background. It works by hard masking, not by reweighting.
math:
For region k with binary mask m: text_k↔text_k true; text_k↔img where m; img_i↔img_j true if m(i)∧m(j) in any region, or neither i nor j is in any region.
Context becomes [main·main_cond_strength, region conds]. Active when start ≤ 1−σ < end.
Separate reorderings of the mask for double and single blocks.

props.architectures: HunyuanVideo-shaped joint blocks in the pack's own forward (not read here); latent [b,c,f,h,w]. Mask size (text+img)² is held in memory.

providers.author: logtd
providers.note: First pass grouped this under densediffusion-cross-attn-mask; the code has no score reweighting.

label: from code
surprise: Region mask is inverted first (1 − mask) before use, so its true area is the zero part of the input mask.
